statement: Kioxia and Sandisk plan to invest over $31 billion in Japan through 2032, contingent upon government support.
why: A large multi-year memory capex plan is a forward read on how much storage supply arrives later this decade.

impact.mechanism: Committed memory capex expands future flash bit supply, easing the storage side of AI buildouts if the government support arrives.
